text:
sam: Heads-up 17: exports map change in @redwood-inference/sdk v1.7.0 broke our Cloudflare Workers sample. Worker errors at import: "Failed to resolve module specifier './dist/index.cjs.js'". repro: `wrangler dev` -> instant failure.

maria: Are we accidentally using require() anywhere? Workers are ESM-only.

sam: Sample uses `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk'`. Bundler resolved to the CJS fallback because of exports conditional ordering. Node was fine, edge picked wrong path.

alex: Paste the exports block? suspect conditional order like {"node":..., "default":...} leading to wrong pick.

sam: package.json snippet:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  }
}
```

kevin: Some edge bundlers ignore the import condition and fall back. Worse: we accidentally kept `withAuthRetry` only in the CJS bundle during last refactor. Edge runtime gets undefined.

maria: Which symbol is missing?

kevin: `withAuthRetry` helper. Node consumers were fine; edge consumers saw runtime errors when invoking it.

sam: Worker log: `TypeError: undefined is not a function at handleRequest` -> traced to withAuthRetry.

alex: CI caught it too.

ci-bot: build/sample-apps  master #482 - test: samples/edge-worker imports failed - log: "Error: Cannot read property 'withAuthRetry' of undefined"

maria: Quick remediation options: 1) change exports so import/default points to mjs explicitly, or 2) re-export withAuthRetry from ESM and cut a patch.

kevin: Re-exporting from ESM + add a test that bundles sample for edge targets (esbuild/rollup) is safest.

sam: I'll open PR to re-export, add tests, and update samples to avoid require.

alex: Also add onboarding README note about package exports + edge bundlers (short checklist + troubleshooting).

maria: Checklist: prefer ESM imports in samples; ensure exports has explicit default/import to mjs; include minimal esbuild config for workers; verify types exposed at ESM entry.

sam: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 includes ESM re-export, tests, README blurb.

kevin: Add changelog note about v1.7.0 exports change. Samples: temporary patch to import directly from `@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.mjs` to buy time.

maria: Also add "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" under the top-level exports subpath for TS toolchains that read exports.types.

kevin: Postmortem actions: SDK: re-export helper in ESM, add exports+types tests, update changelog. Samples: remove implicit require paths, add worker esbuild example. Docs: onboarding note + troubleshooting.

sam: Linking PR in #support so we can triage incoming tickets.

maria: Ping me for review. :thumbsup: 

kevin: Will update Dedicated quickstart snippets once patch is published.

sam: Shipping patch now. :ship:
